newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Nine freeze to death over Moscow's New Year.
newsitem.headline: Nine freeze to death over Moscow's New Year.

text.p: Nine people froze to death on the streets of Moscow and 162 were taken to hospital with frostbite over the New Year and Russian Orthodox Christmas holidays, Interfax news agency said on Wednesday.
The agency quoted emergency medical service officials as saying five of those who died and many of those who suffered frostbite between January 1 and January 7 were homeless.
Festive high jinks on slippery rooftops and windowsills ended in the deaths of another 10 revellers and left 22 injured.
Another 913 Muscovites were treated for injuries as a result of car accidents and falls on icy pavements.
More than a third of them were drunk.
After the warmest autumn on record in western Russia, temperatures plummeted in mid-December to seasonal norms of 10 to 25 degrees Celsius below freezing (14 to minus 13 Fahrenheit)
